title: dev-loop-defect meta-monitor.json: the R8 loop-health decision (trip / no-trip / insufficient-data)
description: Written ONLY by .claude/skills/dev-loop-defect/scripts/meta_monitor.py (no model), on stdout and, with --out, through contracts/emit.py to a caller-chosen path. It compares three loop-health signals (prod_regressed_rate, escalation_rate, repeat_failure_by_area), read through `kb metrics --breakdown`, against loop-limits.json r8_meta_monitor and records the decision. It is REPORT-ONLY unless that section has trip_mode armed and a non-empty armed_by, and the run read its metrics from kb without --report-only; only then may a trip turn the R9 global pause on, through `kb pause --on --by meta-monitor`. It NEVER unpauses. `decision` is the one branch field.

decision.description: trip iff at least one signal is breached; insufficient-data iff no signal is breached and none is ok; else no-trip.

armed.description: True only when limits trip_mode is armed AND armed_by is non-empty AND --report-only was not passed AND the metrics came from kb (not --metrics-file).

action.description: reported: nothing outward was done. paused: `kb pause --on` succeeded. already-paused: the pause was on and its reason was left alone. pause-failed: the pause could not be set (the script exits 1).

value.description: The rate, or the area's escalation count; null when insufficient-data.

denominator.description: null for repeat_failure_by_area, which is a count, not a rate.

breaches.description: One entry per breached signal: the signal name, or repeat_failure_by_area:<area>.

armed_by.description: The human who armed the monitor, from loop-limits.json; present when trip_mode is armed.

attempt.description: OPTIONAL. Which attempt of this stage produced the artifact, 1-based.

retry_reason.description: OPTIONAL. Why this attempt happened, when attempt > 1.

timing.description: OPTIONAL. When this file was written. meta_monitor.py writes with --no-timing so the file is a pure function of the metrics and limits read.
